deped:
LONGER OJT HOURS FOR SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS?
The Department of Education (DepEd) says there is still work to be done, citing feedback from employers who find some senior high school graduates not yet sufficiently prepared for the workplace.
Education Secretary Sonny Angara said DepEd is looking to increase the amount of on-the-job training (OJT) for senior high school students to 640 hours, from the current 80 to 160 hours.
He added that longer OJT could also improve graduates’ chances of being hired by the same employers who trained them.
rene: Rene Baterbonia was not, in any way, connected to University of Santo Tomas before his passing, but it was with the España-based team that his bereaved family found solace as they continue to cope with their loss.
padilla:
'HINDI AKO NABABAGAY SA MUNDONG ITO'
LOOK: Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla announced on Friday, Sept. 18, that he has no plans of running in future elections, saying he wants to focus on raising his young children and living a quiet Islamic life.
In a Facebook post, Padilla endorsed several allies to run as Vice President Sara Duterte's running mate instead, including Sens. Alan Peter Cayetano, Imee Marcos, Bong Go, and Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa, along with Rep. Rodante Marcoleta and former legal counsel Salvador Panelo.
"Halata naman po na hindi ako nababagay sa mundong ito," Padilla said, concluding with: "Revolutionaries do not sit on thrones; they tear them down."
